bioconda.name: bioconductor-scater
bioconda.summary: Single-Cell Analysis Toolkit for Gene Expression Data in R

biotools.summary: Provides some legacy utility functions for performing single-cell analyses. Most of these functions are deprecated in favor of newer, more performant alternatives. We just keep this package around for back-compatibility and to point to the replacement functions.

bioschemas.name: scater
bioschemas.summary: A collection of tools for doing various analyses of single-cell RNA-seq gene expression data, with a focus on quality control and visualization.

galaxy.summary: Scater (Single-Cell Analysis Toolkit for gene Expression data in R) is acollection of tools for doing various analyses of single-cell RNA-seq geneexpression data, with a focus on quality control and visualization.
galaxy.bio_tools_summary: Pre-processing, quality control, normalization and visualization of single-cell RNA-seq data.
